trace.notes: Input URL was normalized as a zbMATH bibliographic resolver for document id 1461251.

zbMATH REST metadata identified the source as Leo J. Schneider, The contest problem book VI. American High School Mathematics Examinations (AHSME) 1989--1994, Anneli Lax New Mathematical Library 40, Mathematical Association of America, 2000. The metadata record itself was not used as a technical source for extraction.

Bounded exact-work recovery checked the exact title with PDF terms, the title plus the 1989--1994 subtitle, and the zbMATH, Open Library, and Internet Archive identifiers. Candidate pages included AMS Bookstore NML/40 and NML/53, AMS eBook collection NML/053, Open Library OL17153679M, Internet Archive item contestproblembo00schn, Cambridge Core, and Google Books. These were rejected because they were catalog, purchase, preview, borrow-only, access-restricted, or blocked pages rather than a readable full-text source containing the problem statements.
Failure mode: metadata_only plus paywalled_or_restricted. No readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source was recovered, so no open-problem extraction was performed.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/1461251.json and outputs/latest.json.
